label: sql-id-ASC
sql: SELECT id FROM Person ORDER BY id ASC

label: gql-id-ASC
sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id ORDER BY p.id ASC

label: gql-limit-ASC
sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS v ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 2

label: sql-id-DESC
sql: SELECT id FROM Person ORDER BY id DESC

label: gql-id-DESC
sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id ORDER BY p.id DESC

label: gql-limit-DESC
sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 2

label: gql-id-alias
sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id

label: gql-name
sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name

label: gql-for-five
sql: GRAPH FinGraph FOR x IN [5,3,1,4,2] RETURN x AS v ORDER BY v LIMIT 5

label: sql-outer-graph
sql: SELECT id FROM GRAPH_TABLE(FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id
